items.facts_min_first: Inani lesheya ekuvalweni kwesimakethe lalingu-${M}, kanti ekuvulweni kwesimakethe lalingu-${S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Inani lesheya ekuvulweni kwesimakethe lalingu-${S}, kanti ekuvalweni kwesimakethe lalingu-${M}.
items.question: Laguquka ngamalini inani lesheya kusukela ekuvulweni kuya ekuvalweni kwesimakethe?
items.distractor_sentence: Le nkampani ilotshwe ohlwini ngenombolo engu-{D}.
items.agreement_note: inani (class 5) uses the invariant past-copulative 'lalingu-'; the dollar figure follows directly and never triggers agreement of its own.
items.gloss_en: The share price was $M at market close, while it was $S at market open. By how much did the share price change from open to close?

items.facts_min_first: Ukuphakama kwendiza kwakungu-{M} m, ngemva kokuba kade kungu-{S} m ekuqaleni.
items.facts_sub_first: Ukuphakama kwendiza kwakungu-{S} m ekuqaleni, ngaphambi kokuba kube ngu-{M} m.
items.question: Kwaguquka ngamalini ukuphakama kwendiza?
items.agreement_note: ukuphakama (class 15, infinitive) takes the fixed concord 'kwakungu-'/'kungu-', which never changes with the numeral's magnitude.
items.gloss_en: The plane's altitude was M m, after having been S m earlier. By how much did the plane's altitude change?

verifier.comment: 'ngemva kokuba kade kungu- ... ekuqaleni' is convoluted, and 'ngamalini' asks about money, not altitude.

items.facts_min_first: Isisindo sengane ngemva kwenyanga sasingu-{M} kg, kuyilapho ngaphambili sasingu-{S} kg.
items.facts_sub_first: Isisindo sengane ngaphambili sasingu-{S} kg, kuyilapho ngemva kwenyanga sasingu-{M} kg.
items.question: Saguquka ngamalini isisindo sengane phakathi kwalezi zikhathi ezimbili?
items.agreement_note: isisindo (class 7) takes the fixed concord 'sasingu-', which agrees with the class-7 subject and is unaffected by the numeral's size.
items.gloss_en: The child's weight after a month was M kg, whereas before it was S kg. By how much did the child's weight change between these two times?

verifier.comment: 'ngamalini' (how much money) is wrong for a weight.

items.facts_min_first: Wayenemali engu-${M} esikhwameni sakhe, wabe esesebenzisa engu-${S} ukuthenga izimpahla esitolo.
items.facts_sub_first: Wasebenzisa imali engu-${S} ukuthenga izimpahla esitolo, ngemva kokuba enemali engu-${M} esikhwameni sakhe.
items.question: Yayiyini ibhalansi yakhe esikhwameni ngemva kokuthenga?
items.agreement_note: imali (class 9) uses the connective 'engu-' throughout; this concord is fixed to the noun's class and does not vary with the numeral.
items.gloss_en: He had $M in his wallet, then he spent $S buying items at the shop. What was his wallet balance after buying?

items.facts_min_first: Kwafakwa imali engu-${M} ku-akhawunti, kamuva kwakhishwa imali engu-${S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Kwakhishwa imali engu-${S} ku-akhawunti, ngaphambi kwalokho bekufakwe imali engu-${M}.
items.question: Yayiyini ibhalansi ye-akhawunti ngemva kwalokhu kokufaka nokukhipha?
items.agreement_note: imali (class 9) again uses the invariant connective 'engu-'; both deposit and withdrawal figures attach the same way regardless of size.
items.gloss_en: $M was deposited into the account, then later $S was withdrawn. What was the account balance after this deposit and withdrawal?

items.facts_min_first: Umndeni wathola imali engeniso engu-${M} ngale nyanga, kodwa wachitha imali engu-${S} ezindlekweni.
items.facts_sub_first: Umndeni wachitha imali engu-${S} ezindlekweni ngale nyanga, kodwa wathola imali engeniso engu-${M}.
items.question: Yayiyini inzuzo noma ilahleko ephelele yomndeni kule nyanga?
items.agreement_note: imali (class 9) keeps the fixed connective 'engu-' whether the figure is the income or the expense amount.
items.gloss_en: The family earned $M in income this month, but spent $S on expenses. What was the family's net result this month?

items.sign_convention: goals scored minus goals conceded, one team over the season
items.facts_min_first: Ithimba lafaka amagoli angu-{M} kule sizini, kodwa lavunyelwa amagoli angu-{S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Ithimba lavunyelwa amagoli angu-{S} kule sizini, kodwa lafaka amagoli angu-{M}.
items.question: Yayiyini umehluko wamagoli wethimba kule sizini?
items.distractor_sentence: Leli thimba lidlale imidlalo engu-{D} kulo nyaka.
items.agreement_note: amagoli (class 6) takes the fixed connective 'angu-'; it agrees with the class-6 noun, not with how large the goal count is.
items.gloss_en: The team scored M goals this season, but conceded S goals. What was the team's goal difference this season?

items.facts_min_first: Umtshalizimali wathola inzuzo engu-${M} kulo nyaka, kodwa wabhekana nokulahlekelwa okungu-${S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Umtshalizimali wabhekana nokulahlekelwa okungu-${S} kulo nyaka, kodwa wathola inzuzo engu-${M}.
items.question: Yayiyini inzuzo noma ilahleko ephelele yomtshalizimali kulo nyaka?
items.agreement_note: the connective 'engu-'/'okungu-' is fixed to the noun it modifies (inzuzo, ukulahlekelwa) and stays the same for any numeral.
items.gloss_en: The investor made $M in gains this year, but faced $S in losses. What was the investor's net result this year?

items.facts_min_first: Umdlali wagcina ngamashothi angu-{M}, kuyilapho i-par yaleli hobhole yayingu-{S}.
items.facts_sub_first: I-par yaleli hobhole yayingu-{S}, kuyilapho umdlali wagcina ngamashothi angu-{M}.
items.question: Yayiyini iskoro somdlali maqondana ne-par?
items.distractor_sentence: Lo mdlali udlala enkundleni yegalofu engu-{D}.
items.agreement_note: amashothi (class 6) takes the fixed connective 'angu-'; i-par (borrowed noun) takes 'yingu-'; neither varies with the numeral's size.
items.gloss_en: The player finished with M strokes, whereas par for this hole was S. What was the player's score relative to par?

items.sign_convention: actual minus scheduled, late counted positive
items.facts_min_first: Isikhathi sokufika kwendiza ngempela sasingu-{M} imizuzu, kuyilapho isikhathi esihleliwe sasingu-{S} imizuzu.
items.facts_sub_first: Isikhathi esihleliwe sokufika kwendiza sasingu-{S} imizuzu, kuyilapho ngempela sasingu-{M} imizuzu.
items.question: Yayiyini umehluko, ngemizuzu, phakathi kwesikhathi sokufika sangempela nesheduli, uma ukuphuza kubalwa njengokuhle?
items.agreement_note: isikhathi (class 7) takes the fixed connective 'sasingu-'; the minute reading follows directly and never inflects for its size.
items.gloss_en: The plane's actual arrival reading was M minutes, whereas the scheduled reading was S minutes. What was the difference, in minutes, between actual and scheduled, counting lateness as positive?

verifier.comment: 'sasingu-3 imizuzu' is calqued word order and 'njengokuhle' is an odd rendering of 'as positive'.

items.sign_convention: party named in the question minus the other party, goal difference
items.facts_min_first: Ithimba i-Alpha lafaka amagoli angu-{M} kulo mdlalo, kanti ithimba i-Beta lafaka amagoli angu-{S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Ithimba i-Beta lafaka amagoli angu-{S} kulo mdlalo, kanti ithimba i-Alpha lafaka amagoli angu-{M}.
items.question: Yayiyini umehluko wamagoli we-Alpha uma kuqhathaniswa ne-Beta?
items.distractor_sentence: Lo mdlalo wawubukwa ngabantu abangu-{D} enkundleni.
items.agreement_note: amagoli (class 6) uses the fixed connective 'angu-' for either team's total, regardless of the numeral's size.
items.gloss_en: Team Alpha scored M goals in this match, while team Beta scored S goals. What was Alpha's goal difference compared to Beta?

items.sign_convention: party named in the question minus the other party, sales
items.facts_min_first: Igatsha lase-Ridge lathengisa izinto ezingu-{M} ngeviki, kanti igatsha lase-Vale lathengisa ezingu-{S}.
items.facts_sub_first: Igatsha lase-Vale lathengisa izinto ezingu-{S} ngeviki, kanti igatsha lase-Ridge lathengisa ezingu-{M}.
items.question: Yayiyini umehluko wentengiso wegatsha lase-Ridge uma kuqhathaniswa negatsha lase-Vale?
items.agreement_note: izinto (class 8) uses the fixed connective 'ezingu-' for either branch's total, unaffected by the numeral's size.
items.gloss_en: The Ridge branch sold M units this week, while the Vale branch sold S units. What was Ridge's sales difference compared to Vale?

items.sign_convention: party named in the question minus the other party, temperature
items.facts_min_first: Idolobha i-Norview lalinezinga lokushisa elingu-{M} °C, kuyilapho idolobha i-Southgate lalinelingu-{S} °C.
items.facts_sub_first: Idolobha i-Southgate lalinezinga lokushisa elingu-{S} °C, kuyilapho idolobha i-Norview lalinelingu-{M} °C.
items.question: Yayiyini umehluko wezinga lokushisa le-Norview uma kuqhathaniswa ne-Southgate?
items.agreement_note: izinga (class 5) takes the fixed connective 'elingu-' for either city's reading, regardless of the numeral's size.
items.gloss_en: Norview had a temperature of M °C, while Southgate had S °C. What was Norview's temperature difference compared to Southgate?

items.sign_convention: party named in the question minus the other party, race time
items.facts_min_first: Umgijimi wokuqala wagijima ngesikhathi esingu-{M} imizuzwana, kanti umgijimi wesibili wagijima ngesingu-{S} imizuzwana.
items.facts_sub_first: Umgijimi wesibili wagijima ngesikhathi esingu-{S} imizuzwana, kanti umgijimi wokuqala wagijima ngesingu-{M} imizuzwana.
items.question: Yayiyini umehluko wesikhathi somgijimi wokuqala uma kuqhathaniswa nowesibili, ngemizuzwana?
items.agreement_note: isikhathi (class 7) takes the fixed connective 'esingu-' for either runner's time, regardless of the numeral's size.
items.gloss_en: The first runner's time was M seconds, while the second runner's time was S seconds. What is the first runner's time difference compared to the second, in seconds?

verifier.comment: 'ngesikhathi esingu-3 imizuzwana' is calqued word order.
